svg.title: GitHub contribution snake
svg.desc: A cyan and teal snake travels through the real GitHub contribution calendar from 2026-07-09 to 2026-10-28. The calendar contains 112 days and 699 contributions. Squares are consumed for the animation and restored each loop. Source as of 2026-10-28T02:39:36.073000+00:00. Reduced-motion mode shows the complete static calendar.

g.text: A little play, built from real contribution history.
